G5584.strongs: to manipulate, i.e. verify by contact; figuratively, to search for
senses: to feel or grope about; with accusative, to feel about for, search after: metaphorically, of seeking God, [[r:ACT.17.27|Act 17:27.]]

to feel, touch, handle: with accusative of person(s), [[r:LUK.24.39|Luk 24:39]], [[r:1JN.1.1|1Jn 1:1]]; προσεληλύθατε ψηλαφωμένῳ (ὄρει ?), [[r:HEB.12.18|Heb 12:18]] (R, txt., a mount that might be touched; mg., a palpable and kindled fire; see Westc., in l).† (AS)

G5504.strongs: "yesterday"; by extension, in time past or hitherto
senses: ἐχθές (Rec. χθές), adv., yesterday: [[r:JHN.4.52|Jhn 4:52]], [[r:ACT.7.28|Act 7:28]], [[r:HEB.13.8|Heb 13:8]] (on the form, see Rutherford, NPhr., 370 f.).† ἐχθές, adverb ={χθές}, yesterday, ( 5th-6th c.BC: Aristophanes Comicus “Nubes” 175, “Th.” 616, etc.; ἀπ᾽ ἐ. “Anthologia Graeca” 11.35 (1st c.BC: Philodemus Gadarensis Epigrammaticus); μέσφα τό γ᾽ ἐ. 3rd c.BC: Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus 2.144); οὐ γάρ τι νῦν γε κἀ. today or yesterday, ( 5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Antigone” 456; οὐκ ἐ. οὐδὲ πρῴην 5th c.BC: Antipho Orator “fragment” 58); ἐ. καὶ τρίτης ( LXX.Ruth.2.11, compare 2nd c.AD: Marcus Antoninus Imperator 10.7. (ἐχθές is commoner than χθές) in Comedy texts and LXX, is the only form used in “NT”, and frequently in papyri of all periods, ( “PSI” 4.442.21 (3rd c.BC), etc.)) (AS)

G5520.strongs: to be bilious, i.e. (by implication) irritable (enraged, "choleric")
senses: = χολοῦμαι, to be angry: with dative of person(s), [[r:JHN.7.23|Jhn 7:23.]]† (AS)

a falsehood, untruth, lie: [[r:REV.14.15|Rev 14:15]]; opposite to ἡ ἀλήθεια, [[r:JHN.8.44|Jhn 8:44]], [[r:ROM.1.25|Rom 1:25]], [[r:EPH.4.25|Eph 4:25]], [[r:2TH.2.11|2Th 2:11]], [[r:1JN.2.21|1Jn 2:21]]; to τὸ ἀληθές, [[r:1JN.2.27|1Jn 2:27]]; ποιεῖν ψ., [[r:REV.21.27|Rev 21:27 22:15]]; ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει κ. σημείοις κ. τέρασιν ψεύδους (genitive qual., see M, Th., 104; and on the meaning and construction, see also ICC, in l), [[r:2TH.2.9|2Th 2:9.]]† (AS)

G5596.root: diminutive from a derivative of the base of [[w:G5597]]
G5596.strongs: a crumb or morsel (as if rubbed off), i.e. a mouthful

G5512.strongs: to throw out the lip, i.e. jeer at

G5553.strongs: a golden article, i.e. gold plating, ornament, or coin
senses: (dimin. of χρυσός, which see), a piece of gold, gold: [[r:1CO.3.12|1Co 3:12]], [[r:HEB.9.4|Heb 9:4]], [[r:1PE.1.7|1Pe 1:7]], [[r:REV.3.18|Rev 3:18 21:18, 21]]; of golden ornaments, [[r:1TI.2.9|1Ti 2:9]] (WH, txt., RV), [[r:1PE.3.3|1Pe 3:3]], [[r:REV.17.4|Rev 17:4 18:16]] (WH, txt., R); of gold coin, money, [[r:ACT.3.6|Act 3:6 20:33]], [[r:1PE.1.18|1Pe 1:18]].† (AS)
(ψεύδομαι), lying, false, untrue (of persons and things): [[r:REV.2.2|Rev 2:2]]; μάρτυρες, [[r:ACT.6.13|Act 6:13]]; as subst., ὁ ψ., a liar: [[r:REV.21.8|Rev 21:8.]]† (AS)

G5546.forms: Χριστιανός (D, Χρεισ-; on the form Χρησ-, see Bl., § 3, 6; 27, 4 on the ending, -ανος, see Bl., ll. with; Deiss., LAE, 382), -οῦ ὁ
G5546.strongs: a Christian, i.e. follower of Christ
senses: a Christian, the name first given to the disciples by pagan gentiles at Antioch: [[r:ACT.11.26|Act 11:26 26:28]], [[r:1PE.4.16|1Pe 4:16]] (see reff. in Thayer, see word; also DB, i, 384).† (AS)

G5500.root: from a comparative of [[w:G5495]] and τείνω (to stretch)
G5500.strongs: to be a hand-reacher or voter (by raising the hand), i.e. (generally) to select or appoint
senses: to vote by stretching out the hand in the Athenian ἐκκλησία (Luc., Plut.).
without vote, [[r:ACT.14.23|Act 14:23]] (see Rackham, in l) (cf. προχειροτονέω).† (AS)

G5559.root: probably akin to the base of [[w:G5530]] through the idea of handling
G5559.strongs: the body (properly, its surface or skin)
senses: in cl. rare in prose, the surface of the body, skin: [[r:ACT.19.12|Act 19:12.]]† (AS)

G5508.strongs: Chios, an island in the Mediterranean
senses: χίος, -ου, ἡ Chios, an island in Ægean Sea: [[r:ACT.20.15|Act 20:15.]]† (AS)

G5551.root: from a presumed compound of [[w:G5550]] and the base of [[w:G5147]]
G5551.strongs: to be a time-wearer, i.e. to procrastinate (linger)

G5586.strongs: a pebble (as worn smooth by handling), i.e. (by implication, of use as a counter or ballot) a verdict (of acquittal) or ticket (of admission); a vote
senses: a small smooth stone, a pebble: ψ. λευκή (for suggestions as to the meaning, see Swete, in l), [[r:REV.2.17|Rev 2:17.]]
From the use of pebbles in voting, a vote: [[r:ACT.26.10|Act 26:10.]]† (AS)

G5530.root: middle voice of a primary verb (perhaps rather from [[w:G5495]], to handle)
G5530.strongs: to furnish what is needed; (give an oracle, "graze" (touch slightly), light upon, etc.), i.e. (by implication) to employ or (by extension) to act towards one in a given manner
senses: χράομαι, χρῶμαι (χρή), to use, make use of: with dative (cf. M, Pr., 64, 158), [[r:ACT.27.17|Act 27:17]], [[r:1CO.9.12|1Co 9:12 9:15]], [[r:1TI.1.8|1Ti 1:8 5:23]]; μᾶλλον χρῆσαι (i.e. the opportunity; see M, Pr., 247), [[r:1CO.7.21|1Co 7:21]]; as some­times in late writers (cf. M, Pr., 64; Lft., Notes, 233), with accusative, [[r:1CO.7.31|1Co 7:31]]; of feelings, etc., to exercise, shew: [[r:2CO.1.17|2Co 1:17 3:12]]; with adv., ἀποτόμως, to deal sharply, [[r:2CO.13.10|2Co 13:10]]; with dative of person(s) (cl.), to treat, deal with, [[r:ACT.27.3|Act 27:3.]]† (AS)

G5540.strongs: employment, i.e. (specially), sexual intercourse (as an occupation of the body)
senses: (χράομαι), use: in a sexual sense, [[r:ROM.1.26|Rom 1:26]]; with genitive obj., θηλείας, [[r:ROM.1.27|Rom 1:27]] (for exx., see Thayer, see word).† (AS)
(see supr.), a whisperer (as epithet of Hermes, Dem., 1358, 6): in bad sense, [[r:ROM.1.30|Rom 1:30.]]† Syn.: καταλάλος, q.v (AS)

G5544.strongs: usefulness, i.e. morally, excellence (in character or demeanor)
senses: goodness of heart, kindness: [[r:ROM.2.4|Rom 2:4]], [[r:2CO.6.6|2Co 6:6]], [[r:GAL.5.22|Gal 5:22]], [[r:COL.3.12|Col 3:12]], [[r:TIT.3.4|Tit 3:4]]; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), [[r:EPH.2.7|Eph 2:7]]; id., opposite to ἀποτομία, [[r:ROM.11.22|Rom 11:22.]] SYN.: see: ἀγαθωσύνη. (AS)
(χρηματίζω, which see), a divine response, an oracle: [[r:ROM.11.4|Rom 11:4]] (Xen., Plat., al.).† (AS)

G5595.strongs: to supply with bits, i.e. (generally) to nourish
senses: (ψωμός, a morsel), to feed with morsels (as children or the sick; Hippocr.), hence, generally, in late writers, to feed, nourish: with accusative of person(s), [[r:ROM.12.20|Rom 12:20]] (LXX); with accusative of thing(s), to give out for food, [[r:1CO.13.3|1Co 13:3]] (cf. WM, § 32, 4an; for dupl. accusative, cf. [[r:NUM.11.4|Num 11:4]], [[r:SIR.15.3|Sir 15:3]], al.).† (AS)

G5567.root: probably strengthened from ψάω (to rub or touch the surface
G5567.strongs: compare); to twitch or twang, i.e. to play on a stringed instrument (celebrate the divine worship with music and accompanying odes)
senses: to pull, twitch, twang (as a bowstring, etc.; Æsch., Eur., al.), hence,
to play a stringed instrument with the fingers (Hdt., Plat., al.);

later, to sing to a harp, sing psalms (LXX); in NT, to sing a hymn, sing praise: [[r:JAS.5.13|Jas 5:13]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:ROM.15.9|Rom 15:9]] (LXX), [[r:EPH.5.19|Eph 5:19]]; dative instr., [[r:1CO.14.15|1Co 14:15.]]† (AS)
(χρηστός, λέγω), fair speaking: in bad sense, [[r:ROM.16.18|Rom 16:18]] (in good sense also, eccl.).† (AS)

G5514.root: feminine of apparently a primary word

G5591.strongs: sensitive, i.e. animate (in distinction on the one hand from, which is the higher or renovated nature; and on the other from, which is the lower or bestial nature)
senses: (ψυχή) of the ψυχή (as the lower part of the immaterial in man), EV, natural: opposite to πνευματικός, [[r:1CO.2.14|1Co 2:14 15:44 15:46]]; πνεῦμα μὴ ἔχοντες (EV, sensual; R, mg., natural or animal; better perhaps, of the mind; see infr.), Ju 19; with ἐπίγειος, δαιμονιώδης, opposite to ἄνωθεν κατερχομένη (σοψία), of the mind (Hort, in l), [[r:JAS.3.15|Jas 3:15]]† (AS)

G5541.strongs: to show oneself useful, i.e. act benevolently

G5517.strongs: dusty or dirty (soil-like), i.e. (by implication) terrene

G5524.strongs: to be a dance-leader, i.e. (generally) to furnish
senses: to lead a χορός (see LS, see word).
to defray the cost of a χορός.
In late writers, metaphorically, with accusative (see M, Pr., 65), to supply, furnish abundantly: [[r:2CO.9.10|2Co 9:10]], [[r:1PE.4.11|1Pe 4:11]] (Polyb., al.).† (AS)

G5570.strongs: a spurious apostle, i.e. pretended pracher

G5569.strongs: a spurious brother, i.e. pretended associate
senses: ψευδ-άδελφος, -ου, ὁ a false brother: of professing Christians, [[r:2CO.11.26|2Co 11:26]], [[r:GAL.2.4|Gal 2:4]].† (AS)

G5587.root: from a derivative of ψίθος (a whisper
G5587.strongs: by implication, a slander; probably akin to); whispering, i.e. secret detraction
senses: of a murmured enchantment, Ec, l.with† (AS)

G5573.strongs: mendacious, i.e. promulgating erroneous Christian doctrine

senses: (ψευδής, ὄνομα) under a false name, falsely called: [[r:1TI.6.20|1Ti 6:20]] (Æsch., Plut., a1.).† (AS)

Χρύσεος, -εα, -εον (-οῦς, -ῆ, -οῦν; on accusative sing. fem., -ᾶν, [[r:REV.1.13|Rev 1:13]] and genitive pl. uncontr., -εων, [[r:REV.2.1|Rev 2:1]], LTr., see M, Pr., 48 and cf. Thackeray, Gr., x, 172 f.) (χρυσός), golden, i.e. made or overlaid with gold: [[r:2TI.2.20|2Ti 2:20]], [[r:HEB.9.4|Heb 9:4]], [[r:REV.1.12|Rev 1:12-13, 20 2:1 4:4 5:8 8:3 9:13, 20 14:14 15:6-7 17:4 21:15]].† (AS)
Χερουβείν (Rec. -βίμ), τά (Heb. כְּרוּב), Cherubim: [[r:HEB.9.6|Heb 9:6]] (cf. [[r:EXO.25.17|Exo 25:17]] (18), al.; see DB, i, 377 ff.).† (AS)

G5554.strongs: gold-ringed, i.e. wearing a golden finger-ring or similar jewelry

G5534.root: third person singular of the same as [[w:G5530]] or [[w:G5531]] used impersonally
senses: χρή impers. (χράω, see LS, see word), it is necessary: [[r:JAS.3.10|Jas 3:10]] (cf. δεῖ.).† (AS)

G5572.strongs: a spurious teacher, i.e. propagator of erroneous Christian doctrine

G5545.strongs: an unguent or smearing, i.e. (figuratively) the special endowment ("chrism") of the Holy Spirit
senses: χρίσμα (T, χρῖσμα, as in cl.; see Tdf., Pr., 102; Bl., § 4, 2), -τος, το (χρίω), later form of χρῖμα (Æsch., al.), an anointing, unction (the result of the action χρίειν; ICC, in l; but cf. Westc., in l, for the view that the oil, not the act, is meant): [[r:1JN.2.20|1Jn 2:20]] [[r:JHN.2.27|Jn 2:27]].† (AS)

G5598.strongs: the last letter of the Greek alphabet, i.e. (figuratively) the finality
senses: Ω, ω, ὦ μέγα (cf. ὂ μικρόν), omega, ô, the twenty-fourth and last letter. As a numeral, ω᾽ = 800, ω, = 800,000. As a symbol of the last (= τὸ τέλος), τὸ Ὦ (Rec. Ω, L, ὦ, T, ω), the Omega: [[r:REV.1.8|Rev 1:8 21:6 22:13]] (cf. Ἄλφα).† (AS)
(χλίω, to become warm), warm, tepid; metaphorically, of persons, luke-warm: [[r:REV.3.16|Rev 3:16.]]† (AS)

G5518.strongs: a chœnix or certain dry measure
senses: a chænix, a dry measure of rather less than a quart: [[r:REV.6.6|Rev 6:6]] (EV, measure).† (AS)

G5558.strongs: to gild, i.e. bespangle with golden ornaments
senses: (χρυσός) to gild, cover with gold: pass., with dative, χρυσίῳ (pleonast., cf. [[r:EXO.26.37|Exo 26:37]]), [[r:REV.17.4|Rev 17:4 18:16]].† (AS)
χρυσό-λιθος, -ου, ὁ a chrysolite (on its identification, see Swete, Ap., 288 f.; DB, iv, 620): [[r:REV.21.20|Rev 21:20.]]† (AS)
